explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 2 received needs keyed by demand record IDs n06-r01 through n06-r08, but its evidence_sources handoff was keyed as s01 through s08. As a result, Job 2 could not match provenance ranks to coverage records and every priority row has upstream_rank 0. The captured upstream assemble_provenance source shows it writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id, which violates the criteria to preserve record identity and deterministic upstream provenance ordering.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs records use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Job 2 input evidence_sources records use record_id values s01 through s08 while also using source_id s01 through s08.
Observed Job 2 priorities have upstream_rank: 0 for every record_id n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Captured assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record_id with source_id.
